name: brave_local_search
description: Search for local businesses and points of interest using Brave Local Search.

name: brave_image_search
description: Search for images using Brave Image Search.

name: brave_video_search
description: Search for videos using Brave Video Search.

name: brave_suggest
description: Get auto-complete query suggestions from Brave Search.

description: Search for financial news, stock data, and market information using Tavily's finance topic mode.

name: search_and_summarize
description: Search the web and return a concise AI-generated answer plus top 3 source links. Best for quick factual lookups.

name: search_news
description: Search for recent news using the best available provider (Tavily news topic or Brave news search).

name: search_recent
description: Search for events from the past 24 hours — news and breaking stories.

description: Search technical documentation sites (MDN, GitHub Docs, npm, Python docs, etc.) for developer reference material.
